assertions.name: borel_half_singularity_at_inv_sqrt2_q1_and_q0_class_change
assertions.source: q=1 level-1/2 root test → 1.3648 (√2 to 3.5%); nearest Padé pole |ξ|=0.6884 ≈ 1/√2 on the positive real axis with 10 real poles accumulating (non-polar); q₀ root test rises +0.5655 (no plateau ⇒ q-Gevrey class change from the Borel side).

description: Lever-1 (z2bn): level-1/2 Borel–Padé singularity hunt for the binding period a_D^(n). q=1 (exact I(n)/n, n≤60): root test extrapolates to sqrt2 (radius rho=1/sqrt2 ~ 0.7071); Padé [28/28] nearest pole on the positive real axis at |xi| ~ rho (Pringsheim) with real poles accumulating beyond rho ⇒ non-polar (branch/essential) singularity — the e^(sqrt n) subexponential signature of a mixed-level transseries. At q0 (n≤28) the level-1/2 root test rises without plateau ⇒ no classical Borel level carries the q0 period (q-Gevrey class; Jackson q-Borel / acceleration chain). The measured (rho, axis, type) datum is the structural target for the open multi-branch super-exp kernel. Anti-fit: expectations derived from proved asymptotics before measurement; exact/categorical inputs; no wiring. Scope-(a).
